persistence.reason: God flags, source claims and handles are excluded from the campaign codec. Only committed loads notify the observer; rejected and aborted loads retain flags and independent protection. Existing campaign schemas and capture deadlines are unchanged.

state.mutation: Installed chat/event action -> validated current entity and owner -> source claim -> reconciled native invulnerability bit
state.outcome: All controlled Warcraft unit categories and replacements inherit enabled protection; explicit English feedback reports ON/OFF.
state.owner: PlayerGodModeController session flags and RuntimeProtection independent per-representation source claims

contains: playerIndex >= 0 and playerIndex < bj_MAX_PLAYERS and enabled[playerIndex]

state.rejection: Missing or removed recipients and retired listeners reject without writes. Uncontrolled entities cannot acquire god protection. Invalid chat preserves flags and authority. Releases affect only the requesting source.

transition.reason: Replacements use current native recipients and ownership. Reinstallation retains the session controller, retires replaced listeners and keeps one load subscription. Removed handles and claims are retired; fresh sessions and committed campaign loads default OFF.
